identity.title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][closeout] Delete terminal reconciliation and receipt-authority machinery

values.task_boundary: Implement only issue #5780 terminal-authority deletion and the minimum active contracts, tests, and documentation required to prove it.
deliverables: Deleted terminal projection and receipt-authority writers
Negative authority and clean-room installation guards
Before-and-after command, source-line, fixture, and artifact metrics
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: no supported workflow creates a second PR or tracked projection solely to record an earlier merge
AC-2: legacy v0.91.7 and v0.91.8 records and receipts remain readable with unchanged compatibility outcomes
AC-3: supported terminal operator surface is finish, status, clean, and bounded read-only compatibility inspection
AC-4: public APIs and schemas expose no current terminal receipt writer, repair, transport, or reconciliation authority
AC-5: complete standalone tests, strict Clippy, schema compatibility, and clean-room install verification pass
AC-6: deletion metrics prove real command, source-line, fixture, and artifact reduction with no hidden wrapper
dependencies: Derived terminal finish and standalone cleanup parity proofs
non_goals: No redesign of planning, validation, review, provider, runtime, or ADL language systems
No destructive rewrite of historical tracked records or Git history
No cleanup of unrelated legacy shell tooling
